about: How a sitting plays in the conversation engine (src/director/sitting.ts): a candidate answers, one question at a time, what an asker puts as a line (owner, Oct 26-29: interviews are scenes). It holds no sentence text: every line is a piece of data/english/parts/conversation.json under the subjects named in a kind's row. A kind of sitting (an interview with a reporter; the debate next) is one row under `kinds`, with its source in code (src/director/interview-sitting.ts) that finds the sitting's record and publishes it.

order.about: The four replies are shown in this order. A candidate who carries a talk on (the trait engine's conversation.reply-reach decision) sees the answers that say more first; one who keeps it short sees the brief ones first.

interview.about: A reporter's interview the candidate said yes to. The press engine puts `stagedBy` on the record and the director stages the `interview-sitting` situation type from it; `published` is the record the interview's end writes.
